propositions: A code-review finding raised on one patchset and not re-emitted on the next reaches no consumer, causing findings to vanish across patchsets and defects to merge undetected.

The reader must classify prior findings by region state (still-present, addressed, withdrawn) and carry only eligible items (surfaced-only, grounded-only, top 12 by priority) forward to merge_findings.
Carried findings must never raise posture from their origin decision; a blocking_enabled criterion changed between patchsets must not cause a carried advisory to block.

The dispatcher injects carried items as standing_findings workflow input post-Pass-1 into merge_findings, which appends those absent from fresh Pass-1, and the verifier marks them with Gerrit text naming the origin patchset.
An already-carried item (bearing a standing object) classifies as withdrawn and is not carried again, ensuring the chain terminates after one patchset.
